infoItem.layoutProp: Places the title and description in a vertical stack or on one line.
infoItem.childrenProp: Composable leading, content, and trailing parts.
infoItem.classNameProp: Additional classes applied to the item.
infoItem.groupPart: Optional bordered group that separates adjacent items.
infoItem.leadingPart: Fixed-size leading slot for an icon, avatar, or thumbnail.
infoItem.contentPart: Flexible container for the title and supporting description.
infoItem.titlePart: Primary label for the information row.
infoItem.trailingPart: Right-aligned slot for values, status, controls, or compact custom content.
infoItem.valuePart: Tabular-numeric text style for a trailing value.
